prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: painted limb construction atlas for an articulated overhead walking animation in Age of Fronts.
Image 1 is the Russian Bronze Age handcart merchant. Image 2 is the Russian Stone Age basket carrier. They are MATERIAL, LIGHTING, ANATOMY and PAINTERLY STYLE REFERENCES only. Their finished unit masters remain unchanged. Make a NEW reusable transparent six-part leg atlas, with no whole person or cargo.

Canvas/layout: square transparent RGBA canvas, exactly THREE equal columns by TWO equal rows, with NO visible grid, labels, lines or background. Six isolated painted pieces, ONE piece centered in EACH of the six cells. At least 35 pixels of completely empty transparent space at each cell edge. All pieces aligned vertically, upper joint at screen-top, lower joint/toes at screen-bottom. The upper row is the person's LEFT leg; lower row is the person's RIGHT leg. Column 1: thigh. Column 2: shin. Column 3: closed hide boot. Exactly six separate objects.

Camera: the same pure overhead/downward-looking orthographic character camera as the two references. Feet point SCREEN-DOWN, showing the top of each closed toe and the upper rawhide instep lacing, NEVER an upright side profile, sole underside or side-view standing shoe. The clothing is simple warm brown prehistoric hide trousers, lower-leg rawhide wraps, closed brown hide footwear, matching BOTH reference merchants' existing legs. No armor, metal, modern rubber outsole, fantasy ornament, feet skin, labels, captions, extra joints, shadow outside the parts or scenery.

THIGH cells: one simple tapering connected trouser section from hidden upper hip to knee, brown soft hide with quiet creases and upper-left highlights. Straight relaxed neutral anatomy, roughly 2.4 times longer than its width. BOTH terminal joint areas are rounded and fully painted for overlap in a skeletal rig, not severed flesh or bone.
SHIN cells: one brown wrapped lower leg section from knee to ankle, same scale/width family as the thigh. Simple diagonal rawhide ties near the ankle, rounded painted overlap at knee and ankle. Roughly 2.8 times longer than width. No boot/toes attached to these two shin pieces.
BOOT cells: one closed brown rawhide shoe seen from above, toes at bottom, a rounded broad closed toe, clear warm leather instep, two simple crossed rawhide laces, a narrow soft collar at screen-top. Roughly 1.6 times longer than width. A real matching left and right shoe, with a subtle outward big-toe shape, no visible human foot and no long trouser segment attached.

Render all six at the same believable human scale, with matched warm upper-left lighting and crisp finished painted game textures. They must assemble into two connected walking legs under the approved merchants' tunics. Clean opaque interiors, clean smooth silhouette edges, genuine alpha outside, no colored matte or detached speckles. Keep generous cell margins. Do not add the merchant torso, head, hands, basket, wagon, wheels, cargo, weapons, body, text or animation frames.
purpose: Separate painted thigh, shin and shoe textures for complete articulated gait.
